title: BlockDisplays
body:
# Features Choose between **three** different sizes to create miniature blocks of any available item in the game.
Easily animate your blocks by making them spin, giving them a customised rotation angle and time interval! # Animation Miniature blocks can easily be animated with the use of the command **/bd edit settings**.
Once you edited the miniature settings the block will update on its own!
**Note:** using the reload command will restart all running animations.
Commands # Commands - /bd - Shows plugin's help lines - /bd help - Shows general help or specific help when a command is specified - /bd create - Creates a miniature block at player's location - /bd delete - Deletes an existing miniature block. - /bd edit - lets you edit a block's location, facing/rotation and settings to animate the blocks. - /bd list - Shows a list of all existing miniature blocks - /bd version - Shows the current plugin's version and details - /bd info - Shows all details for a specific existing block - /bd teleport - Teleports a player to a block or a block to a player's location.
Permissions # Permissions - blockdisplays.command.help - Gives access to /bd help command - blockdisplays.command.create - Gives access to /bd create command - blockdisplays.command.delete - Gives access to /bd delete command - blockdisplays.command.teleport - Gives access to /bd teleport command - blockdisplays.command.list - Gives access to /bd list command - blockdisplays.command.version - Gives access to /bd version command - blockdisplays.command.info- Gives access to /bd info command - blockdisplays.command.edit - Gives access to /bd edit command
# Issues Open a new issue [here](https://github.com/Hetag1216/BlockDisplays/issues).
When opening a new issue please add and specify: - Provider's version (spigot, paper, bukkit) - /version; - BlockDisplays' version - /bd version; - Where/when you met the issue, what you were doing when the error happened; - Error log. # Support


I do my best to provide support for my projects over discord.
If you'd have questions or support requests feel free to join!

# Metrics This plugin collects anonymous server statistics which helps me keep track of the plugin's usage.
I invite you to keep this setting on as it contributes to boosting my dedication and work towards my projects! Provided by [bStats](https://bstats.org/).
